BiblicalUsage: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, because they would not serve his gods nor worship the golden image.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that rage is the confession of a king who cannot command a conscience.
